Test harness for fddev configure, workspace, ready, and dev command execution.

# Purpose
This file defines a test driver for the `fddev` command flow. It starts a separate supervisor process, loads the default configuration, initializes the topology, and then runs a sequence of child processes that exercise `configure`, `wksp`, `dev`, and `ready`. The [`main`](<#main>) function calls [`fddev_test_run`](<#fddev_test_run>), which either runs the test path or passes control to `fd_dev_main` when the command line does not match the test setup.

The file also contains the process control logic used by the test. The [`fork_child`](<#fork_child>) function creates a pipe and forks a child process, and [`wait_children`](<#wait_children>) waits for child exit by using `poll` and `waitpid`. The helper functions [`fddev_configure`](<#fddev_configure>), [`fddev_wksp`](<#fddev_wksp>), [`fddev_ready`](<#fddev_ready>), and [`fddev_dev`](<#fddev_dev>) call the related command entry points after permission checks with `fd_cap_chk`. The [`fddev_dev`](<#fddev_dev>) path also starts [`spawn_agave`](<#spawn_agave>), while [`fddev_configure`](<#fddev_configure>) skips the `kill` stage so the test does not stop itself.
